skillsbench-host-grading.name: skillsbench-host-grading
key_points: ALWAYS verify environment/baseline/ and environment/workspace/ are complete — placeholders aren't enough; tests compare baseline↔workspace. Copy complete directory trees from the running container to the task directory.
ALWAYS read `tests/test_outputs.py` before writing output — it defines the exact JSON schema, field names, tolerance (e.g., `rel_tol=0.001`), and file paths the verifier checks.
skillsbench-host-grading.description: How SkillsBench host verification works — where deliverables must live, what the verifier checks, and common pitfalls.

skillsbench-host-verification.name: skillsbench-host-verification
key_points: ALWAYS write deliverables to the task directory (`tasks/<id>/`), NOT to `/root/` on the host filesystem. The host verifier only stages files from the task directory to `<stage>/root/`.
ALWAYS prefer local/offline tools over cloud APIs (e.g., local `openai-whisper` over OpenAI Whisper API) — containers may lack API keys or network access.
ALWAYS verify recall/precision locally against the test's matching algorithm before submitting — tolerance windows, word normalization, and equivalence groups matter as much as raw counts.
